# Pacing experiment tables (generated by scripts/10_pacing_experiment.py)

Model-based estimates: simulated demand x realised average CI. Reduction (%) = 100 (E_hist - E_policy) / E_hist. Overrides = days the rule replaced the policy's first-ranked action. High days by quarter = High-event days in each quarter of the window. fcst_CI_gap_high_days = mean forecast CI 16-21 h on High-event days minus other days (g/kWh). B = borrowing allowance of the pacing rule (p/kWh x days), chosen on validation.
